verdict.rationale: Fern's docs explicitly document a Versions feature that adds a dropdown for multiple releases of the same content, each with its own tabs/sections/pages/API references, letting readers switch versions from the site (fern-docs-13, fern-docs-28). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation or a live probe of the version dropdown in action, and no detail on per-product (vs. per-API) version scoping.
